frontMatter.title: Thursday Club Night: Badminton Fun!
frontMatter.summary: Join us for Thursday Club Night with all four courts open for play. Enjoy a fun evening of badminton without any league or cup matches.

prev.title: Four League Titles in One Week!
prev.summary: Our teams secured four league titles in just one week, showcasing incredible skill and teamwork. Celebrate with us as we honor our dedicated players and supporters.
